# PopNow Developer MCP Server

> The PopNow Developer MCP Server is a hosted Model Context Protocol server at https://api.popnow.ai/api/v1/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless) for developers. Coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline) and your own MCP clients connect with a PopNow API key (`Authorization: Bearer sk-popnow-...`) to create images, videos, music and voiceovers, run any PopNow model by its API ID, follow tasks and install agent skills. Billing is in USD from the PopNow API balance.

This repository holds the setup guide, API key configs for each client, an MCP registry manifest (server.json, io.github.popnow-ai/popnow-api-mcp) and @popnow/mcp, a stdio bridge on npm (`npx -y @popnow/mcp`) for clients that only run local servers.

- Auth: API keys only, from https://popnow.ai/api/console/keys. No OAuth on this endpoint. The key's model allow-list, IP allow-list and spend caps apply.
- Billing: every paid tool quotes first in USD (`needs_confirmation: true`, `cost_usd`, `available_usd`); call it again with `max_usd` (a decimal string) set to the approved price. There is no automatic approval threshold.
- Developer tools: `create_task` (any model ID with the model's own `input`), `get_task`, `list_tasks`, `install_skill`. Named media tools include create_image, edit_image, create_video, create_music, create_speech, apply_effect, remove_background, upscale, compose_video; plus check_balance and list_models.
- Typical prices: image about $0.048, 5-second video about $0.185, song about $0.072, background removal $0.0048.
- Long jobs return a `job_id`; call `get_task` (wait_seconds 0 to 50) to collect the result.
- The old address https://api.popnow.ai/mcp accepts API keys until 31 January 2027; @popnow/mcp 0.2.0 and newer default to the new endpoint.
- For the ChatGPT and Claude apps with a PopNow account and website credits, use https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-mcp instead.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-api-mcp#readme): setup per client, tools, USD quotes, limits, FAQ
- [Developer MCP docs](https://popnow.ai/docs/mcp): official documentation with the full parameter reference
- [Developer MCP page](https://popnow.ai/api/mcp)
- [REST API quickstart](https://popnow.ai/docs/quickstart): the same models over HTTP
- [llms.txt for PopNow docs](https://popnow.ai/docs/llms.txt)

## Files

- [examples/](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-api-mcp/tree/main/examples): API key configs for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Codex and generic clients
- [server.json](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-api-mcp/blob/main/server.json): MCP registry manifest
- [packages/popnow-mcp](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-api-mcp/tree/main/packages/popnow-mcp): @popnow/mcp stdio bridge (env POPNOW_API_KEY, optional POPNOW_MCP_URL)
